testflight_internal.description: Archive Waffle (iOS), export an IPA, and upload to TestFlight for internal testing. Build number is auto-managed by the Xcode Run Script phase (git commit count). Signing uses the App Store Connect API key from .env (ASC_KEY_ID / ASC_ISSUER_ID / ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH) when set, so it does not depend on an Apple ID being signed into Xcode.

steps.name: validate_inputs
steps.run: if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then echo "VERSION is required (e.g. asc workflow run testflight_internal VERSION:1.0)" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -z "$APP_ID" ]; then APP_ID="$ASC_APP_ID"; fi; if [ -z "$APP_ID" ]; then echo "APP_ID is required (set ASC_APP_ID in .env or pass APP_ID:<id>)" >&2; exit 1; fi

steps.name: archive
steps.run: AUTH_FLAGS=""; if [ -n "$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH" ]; then AUTH_FLAGS="--xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyPath --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_KEY_ID --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyIssuerID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_ISSUER_ID"; fi; asc xcode archive --project "$PROJECT_PATH" --scheme "$SCHEME" --configuration "$CONFIGURATION" --archive-path ".asc/artifacts/Waffle-$VERSION.xcarchive" --clean --overwrite --xcodebuild-flag=-destination --xcodebuild-flag=generic/platform=iOS --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates $AUTH_FLAGS --xcodebuild-flag=MARKETING_VERSION=$VERSION --output json

steps.name: export
steps.run: AUTH_FLAGS=""; if [ -n "$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH" ]; then AUTH_FLAGS="--xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyPath --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_KEY_ID --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyIssuerID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_ISSUER_ID"; fi; asc xcode export --archive-path ${steps.archive.ARCHIVE_PATH} --export-options "$EXPORT_OPTIONS" --ipa-path ".asc/artifacts/Waffle-$VERSION.ipa" --overwrite --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates $AUTH_FLAGS --output json

steps.name: upload
steps.run: if [ -z "$APP_ID" ]; then APP_ID="$ASC_APP_ID"; fi; asc builds upload --app "$APP_ID" --ipa ${steps.export.IPA_PATH} --wait --output json
